exam: IBPS AFO (Agriculture Field Officer) Scale-I — CRP SPL-XVI
title_en: Agriculture Professional Knowledge — Final Hard Mock
title_hi: कृषि व्यावसायिक ज्ञान — फाइनल हार्ड मॉक
pattern_en: 50 Questions | 100 Marks | 40 Minutes | 5 options (A–E) | Negative marking: 1/4th of the marks assigned to the question
pattern_hi: 50 प्रश्न | 100 अंक | 40 मिनट | 5 विकल्प (A–E) | नेगेटिव मार्किंग: प्रश्न के निर्धारित अंकों का 1/4 भाग

questions.q_en: A crop shows interveinal chlorosis on the youngest leaves while the older leaves remain green. The nutrient most likely deficient is:
questions.q_hi: एक फसल में सबसे नई पत्तियों पर शिराओं के बीच पीलापन दिख रहा है जबकि पुरानी पत्तियाँ हरी हैं। सर्वाधिक संभावित कमी किस पोषक तत्व की है?
questions.exp_en: Calcium is phloem-immobile (along with Fe, Zn, Mn, Cu, B, Mo), so its deficiency appears first on young leaves. Mg, N, P and K are phloem-mobile, so their deficiency shows first on older leaves — Mg deficiency also shows interveinal chlorosis, but on older leaves.

questions.q_en: The pF value of field capacity (suction 0.33 bar) is approximately:
questions.q_hi: क्षेत्र धारिता (फील्ड कैपेसिटी, सक्शन 0.33 बार) का pF मान लगभग है:
questions.exp_en: Field capacity = 0.33 bar = 10^2.54 cm of water, so pF 2.54. Permanent wilting point (−15 bar) is pF 4.2, hygroscopic coefficient pF 4.5 and saturation pF 0.

questions.q_en: The pF value of the hygroscopic coefficient is:
questions.q_hi: आर्द्रताग्राही गुणांक (हाइग्रोस्कोपिक कोएफिशिएंट) का pF मान है:
questions.exp_en: Hygroscopic coefficient = pF 4.5 (about 31 bar). For reference: field capacity pF 2.54, permanent wilting point pF 4.2, and capillary/moisture equivalent is around pF 2.7–2.8.

questions.q_en: In a neutron moisture meter, the detector used to sense thermalised neutrons is:
questions.q_hi: न्यूट्रॉन मॉइस्चर मीटर में उष्मीकृत न्यूट्रॉनों को संसूचित (डिटेक्ट) करने वाला उपकरण होता है:
questions.exp_en: The Am–Be source emits fast neutrons; hydrogen in soil thermalises them and a boron trifluoride (BF3) proportional counter detects the thermalised flux. Gypsum blocks and tensiometers measure matric suction, not neutron flux.

questions.q_en: The 'Akiochi' (autumn decline) disorder of rice in degraded paddy soils is primarily caused by the toxicity of:
questions.q_hi: अवनत धान मृदा में धान का 'अकियोची' (शरद ऋतु क्षय) विकार मुख्यतः किसकी विषाक्तता से होता है?
questions.exp_en: Akiochi occurs in poorly drained, degraded paddy soils where sulphate reduction produces H2S, which damages rice roots and induces iron deficiency. Drainage, mid-season drying and iron/manganese management reduce its severity.

questions.q_en: A soil sample shows pH 9.2, EC 1.2 dS/m, ESP 22% and a dispersed surface crust with white efflorescence. The soil is best classified as:
questions.q_hi: एक मृदा नमूने का pH 9.2, EC 1.2 dS/m, ESP 22% है तथा सतह पर फैली पर्त व सफेद शोरा जमा है। यह मृदा सर्वोत्तम रूप से किस प्रकार की है?
questions.exp_en: Sodic soil: pH > 8.5, ESP > 15%, EC < 4 dS/m and dispersed structure; reclaimed with gypsum. Saline soil has EC > 4 dS/m, pH < 8.5, ESP < 15% and a flocculated structure, and is reclaimed by leaching.

questions.q_en: Lime requirement of an acidic soil is estimated mainly from its content of:
questions.q_hi: अम्लीय मृदा की चूना आवश्यकता मुख्यतः किसकी मात्रा से आँकी जाती है?
questions.exp_en: Lime requirement is based on exchangeable/total acidity (Al3+ + H+) and is measured by buffer-pH (SMP) or titration methods; exchangeable sodium relates to gypsum requirement of sodic soils.

questions.q_en: Adding a selected microbial inoculum to soil to accelerate the degradation of a pollutant is called:
questions.q_hi: किसी प्रदूषक के अपघटन को तेज करने के लिए चयनित सूक्ष्मजीव निवेश मृदा में मिलाना कहलाता है:
questions.exp_en: Bioaugmentation = addition of specific microorganisms. Biostimulation = stimulating indigenous microbes by adding nutrients/oxygen; phytoremediation uses plants.

questions.q_en: Puddling in paddy fields is done primarily to:
questions.q_hi: धान के खेत में पडलिंग मुख्यतः किस उद्देश्य से की जाती है?
opts_en: Destroy soil structure and reduce percolation losses
Improve aeration of the root zone
opts_hi: मृदा संरचना नष्ट करके रिसाव हानि घटाना
मृदा थोक घनत्व स्थायी रूप से बढ़ाना
questions.exp_en: Puddling destroys aggregates and creates a less permeable plough pan, reducing percolation and helping standing water. Its downside is poor structure for the following crop, which is why zero tillage/raised beds are promoted after paddy.

questions.q_en: Lint index in cotton is the weight of lint obtained from:
questions.q_hi: कपास में लिंट इंडेक्स कितने बीजों से प्राप्त लिंट का भार है?
questions.exp_en: Lint index = weight of lint (g) from 100 seeds; ginning outturn (%) = (lint weight ÷ seed cotton weight) × 100. Seed index is the weight of 100 fuzzy seeds.

questions.q_en: Baby corn is harvested at:
questions.q_hi: बेबी कॉर्न की कटाई किस अवस्था पर की जाती है?
opts_hi: सिल्किंग के 2–3 दिन बाद, निषेचन से पहले
questions.exp_en: Baby corn cobs are picked 2–3 days after silking, before fertilisation, when the cob is 5–10 cm and the silk has just emerged; delayed harvest makes the cob fibrous.

questions.q_en: The unit of Specific Leaf Area (SLA) is:
questions.q_hi: विशिष्ट पर्ण क्षेत्र (SLA) की इकाई है:
questions.exp_en: SLA = leaf area ÷ leaf dry mass (cm2/g). Its reciprocal is Specific Leaf Weight (SLW, g/cm2); high SLA indicates thin, broader leaves.

questions.q_en: Removal of excess soil water using the bio-energy of deep-rooted plants is termed:
questions.q_hi: गहरी जड़ वाले पौधों की जैव-ऊर्जा से अतिरिक्त मृदा जल निकालने को कहते हैं:
questions.exp_en: Bio-drainage uses fast-growing deep-rooted trees (e.g. Eucalyptus, Acacia, Casuarina) that transpire large volumes of water, lowering the water table in waterlogged, saline areas.

questions.q_en: Which of the following is known as a 'fertilizer tree' in agroforestry?
questions.q_hi: कृषि वानिकी में निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'उर्वरक वृक्ष' कहा जाता है?
questions.exp_en: Gliricidia sepium is a nitrogen-fixing legume tree whose loppings are used as green leaf manure; other fertilizer trees include Leucaena, Sesbania and Subabul.

questions.q_en: The most desirable characteristic of trees grown in alley cropping is:
questions.q_hi: एली क्रॉपिंग में उगाए जाने वाले वृक्षों का सर्वाधिक वांछनीय गुण है:
questions.exp_en: Alley cropping uses leguminous trees (Gliricidia, Leucaena, Sesbania) that fix nitrogen and are pruned periodically to supply mulch and nutrients; deep roots avoid competition with the intercrop.

questions.q_en: Which crop is used as a trap crop for the red hairy caterpillar in groundnut?
questions.q_hi: मूँगफली में लाल रोमिल सुंडी के लिए ट्रैप फसल के रूप में कौन-सी फसल प्रयोग होती है?
questions.exp_en: Cowpea is a preferred trap crop: moths lay eggs on cowpea rows, which are then sprayed or destroyed, protecting the main groundnut crop.

questions.q_en: Among surface, sprinkler and drip systems, the highest water application efficiency is generally obtained in:
questions.q_hi: सतही, स्प्रिंकलर और टपक सिंचाई में सर्वाधिक जल अनुप्रयोग दक्षता सामान्यतः किसमें मिलती है?
questions.exp_en: Drip applies water directly to the root zone with about 90% application efficiency, compared with about 70–80% for sprinkler and 35–50% for surface methods.

questions.q_en: A rainfed farmer faces a delay of 4–6 weeks in monsoon onset. The most appropriate contingent measure is:
questions.q_hi: एक वर्षा-आधारित किसान को मानसून 4–6 सप्ताह देर से मिलता है। सर्वाधिक उपयुक्त आपातकालीन उपाय है:
opts_en: Sow the long-duration variety with a higher seed rate
Switch to short-duration varieties of a suitable crop with a shorter growing period
Delay sowing until the next season
Abandon all inputs and wait for rain
opts_hi: लंबी अवधि की किस्म अधिक बीज दर से बोना
कम अवधि वाली उपयुक्त फसल की लघु-अवधि किस्मों पर स्विच करना
बुवाई से पहले भारी नाइट्रोजन देना
सभी निवेश छोड़कर वर्षा की प्रतीक्षा करना
questions.exp_en: Contingent crop planning substitutes long-duration crops with short-duration/alternate crops and varieties that fit the shortened season, so that the crop matures before terminal moisture stress.

questions.q_en: Which rice variety is known as the 'miracle rice of India'?
questions.q_hi: किस धान किस्म को 'भारत का चमत्कारी चावल' कहा जाता है?
questions.exp_en: Jaya (Taichung Native 1 × T-141) was India's first high-yielding semi-dwarf rice variety, released in 1968 and called the miracle rice of India; IR-8 is known as the miracle rice of the world.

questions.q_en: Leaf Colour Chart (LCC) is used for:
questions.q_hi: लीफ कलर चार्ट (LCC) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
opts_en: Need-based nitrogen top dressing in rice
opts_hi: धान में आवश्यकता आधारित नाइट्रोजन टॉप ड्रेसिंग
गेहूँ में जिंक की कमी पहचानना
questions.exp_en: LCC compares the colour of the topmost fully opened leaf with graded green strips; nitrogen is applied only when the reading falls below the critical value, improving nitrogen use efficiency in rice.

questions.q_en: The quincunx system of planting accommodates how many times more plants than the square system of the same spacing?
questions.q_hi: समान दूरी वाले वर्गाकार रोपण की तुलना में क्विंकंक्स (पंचकोण) रोपण प्रणाली में कितने गुना अधिक पौधे लगाए जा सकते हैं?
questions.exp_en: Quincunx is a square system with a filler tree at the centre of each square, so the plant population becomes almost double (2 ×). Fillers are removed as the main trees grow.

questions.q_en: Kew, Queen and Mauritius are commercial varieties of:
questions.q_hi: क्यू, क्वीन तथा मॉरीशस किस फल की व्यावसायिक किस्में हैं?
questions.exp_en: Kew (the commercial canning variety), Queen and Mauritius are pineapple varieties; Giant Kew is the most widely planted cultivar in India.

questions.q_en: Red Delicious is a variety of:
questions.q_hi: रेड डेलिशियस किसकी किस्म है?
questions.exp_en: Red Delicious, Royal Delicious and Golden Delicious are apple varieties; apple needs about 1,000–1,500 chilling hours, which is why it is grown in high hills.

questions.q_en: The optimum soil pH range for grape cultivation is:
questions.q_hi: अंगूर की खेती के लिए उपयुक्त मृदा pH परासर है:
questions.exp_en: Grape prefers a pH of about 5.5–6.5 with good drainage; it is sensitive to free lime and to waterlogging, and is commercially grown in Nashik, Sangli and Solapur.

questions.q_en: Planting seedlings at a spacing closer than the normal recommended spacing is called:
questions.q_hi: सामान्य अनुशंसित दूरी से कम दूरी पर पौध रोपित करना कहलाता है:
questions.exp_en: High density planting (HDP) uses closer spacing and dwarf/compact canopies to raise plant population and early yields per hectare; ultra-high density planting is used in apple and guava.

questions.q_en: Button mushroom (Agaricus bisporus) is harvested at the:
questions.q_hi: बटन मशरूम (Agaricus bisporus) की कटाई किस अवस्था पर की जाती है?
opts_en: Button stage, before the veil breaks
Stage when the cap turns brown
opts_hi: बटन अवस्था, पर्दा (वील) खुलने से पहले
questions.exp_en: Button mushroom is harvested at the button stage, when the veil is intact and the cap is still closed; post-harvest browning is checked by sulphite treatment, low temperature and modified atmosphere.

questions.q_en: The 'ooze test' in plant disease diagnosis is used to detect:
questions.q_hi: पादप रोग निदान में 'ऊज़ टेस्ट' किसके संसूचन के लिए प्रयोग होता है?
questions.exp_en: In the ooze test, a diseased tissue piece is suspended in water; milky bacterial streaming from the cut end confirms bacterial disease. Fungal and viral infections do not ooze in this manner.

questions.q_en: The downy mildew genus in which secondary and tertiary sporangiophore branches arise at right angles to the main axis is:
questions.q_hi: वह डाउनी मिल्ड्यू वंश जिसमें द्वितीयक एवं तृतीयक शाखाएँ मुख्य अक्ष से समकोण पर निकलती हैं, है:
questions.exp_en: Plasmopara (e.g. P. viticola on grape) has branches at right angles to the main axis; Peronospora has dichotomous branching, Bremia has swollen branch tips, and Sclerospora has stout, short branches.

questions.q_en: Ufra disease of rice is caused by a:
questions.q_hi: धान का उफ्रा रोग किसके कारण होता है?
questions.exp_en: Ufra is caused by the stem nematode Ditylenchus angustus; affected panicles remain in the boot or emerge deformed with distorted grain. Tungro, by contrast, is a virus spread by green leafhopper.

questions.q_en: Damping-off of tomato seedlings in nursery beds is most commonly caused by:
questions.q_hi: नर्सरी क्यारियों में टमाटर के पौधों का डैंपिंग ऑफ सर्वाधिक सामान्यतः किससे होता है?
questions.exp_en: Pythium aphanidermatum (a water mould) causes pre- and post-emergence damping-off in warm, wet nursery beds. Raising beds, drenching with Trichoderma or metalaxyl and avoiding overwatering are the main controls.

questions.q_en: Citrus greening (HLB) is caused by:
questions.q_hi: सिट्रस ग्रीनिंग (HLB) किससे होता है?
opts_en: Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus, transmitted by the citrus psyllid
Xanthomonas citri, transmitted by wind-driven rain
Citrus tristeza virus, transmitted by aphids
opts_hi: कैंडिडेटस लिबेरिबैक्टर एशियाटिकस, सिट्रस सिलिड द्वारा संचरित
questions.exp_en: HLB is a phloem-limited bacterial disease caused by Candidatus Liberibacter spp.; in India the Asian form is spread by Diaphorina citri. There is no cure — control relies on disease-free nursery stock and vector management.

questions.q_en: Beauveria bassiana is used in biological control as an:
questions.q_hi: ब्यूवेरिया बेसियाना का जैविक नियंत्रण में उपयोग किस रूप में होता है?
questions.exp_en: Beauveria bassiana is a white-muscardine fungus that infects larvae and adults of many pests, including cotton bollworm. Metarhizium anisopliae is the green-muscardine fungus; Bt is the bacterial insecticide.

questions.q_en: The guava pest whose female lays eggs on the soft skin of ripening fruit and whose maggots bore into the pulp is:
questions.q_hi: वह अमरूद कीट जिसकी मादा पकते फल की कोमल त्वचा पर अंडे देती है और उसके मैगट गूदे में छेद करते हैं, है:
questions.exp_en: Bactrocera dorsalis (oriental fruit fly) attacks guava, mango and peach. Control uses methyl eugenol pheromone traps, field sanitation and bagging of fruit.

questions.q_en: The term 'epizootic' is associated with:
questions.q_hi: 'एपिज़ूटिक' शब्द किससे संबद्ध है?
opts_en: An epidemic of disease in an insect population
A severe nutrient deficiency in crops
A sudden increase in soil microbial biomass
A plant disease caused by viroids
opts_hi: कीट जनसंख्या में रोग की महामारी
मृदा सूक्ष्मजीव बायोमास में अचानक वृद्धि
questions.exp_en: An epizootic is a disease outbreak in an animal/insect population (the animal equivalent of an epidemic). Such outbreaks by pathogens like Beauveria or NPV are used in microbial control.

questions.q_en: The secretory organ of the silkworm located at the junction of the midgut and hindgut is:
questions.q_hi: रेशम कीट में मध्यांत्र एवं पश्चांत्र के संधि स्थल पर स्थित स्रावी अंग है:
questions.exp_en: Malpighian tubules are the excretory organs of insects, opening at the midgut–hindgut junction. Silk glands, in contrast, open through the spinneret in the head.

questions.q_en: Kusum (Schleichera oleosa) is a host tree of:
questions.q_hi: कुसुम (Schleichera oleosa) किसका आश्रय वृक्ष है?
questions.exp_en: Kusum, palas (Butea monosperma) and ber (Ziziphus mauritiana) are the major host trees of the lac insect Kerria lacca; kusum lac is valued for its superior colour.

questions.q_en: A mutation that changes the DNA sequence but does not alter the sequence of amino acids in the protein is called:
questions.q_hi: वह उत्परिवर्तन जो DNA अनुक्रम बदल देता है परंतु प्रोटीन में अमीनो अम्ल अनुक्रम नहीं बदलता, कहलाता है:
questions.exp_en: Silent (synonymous) mutations exploit the degeneracy of the genetic code — the new codon codes for the same amino acid. Nonsense creates a stop codon, missense substitutes an amino acid, and frameshift shifts the reading frame.

questions.q_en: Variation arising from any form of cell or tissue culture is known as:
questions.q_hi: किसी भी प्रकार के कोशिका या ऊतक संवर्धन से उत्पन्न विभिन्नता कहलाती है:
questions.exp_en: Somaclonal variation is the heritable variation recovered from callus or cell cultures, often due to chromosome rearrangements and methylation changes; it has been used to select disease-resistant lines.

questions.q_en: High heritability coupled with high genetic advance indicates the predominance of:
questions.q_hi: उच्च वंशागतिकता के साथ उच्च आनुवंशिक प्रगति किसकी प्रधानता दर्शाती है?
questions.exp_en: High heritability with high genetic advance shows that additive variance governs the trait, so simple selection is effective. High heritability with low genetic advance indicates non-additive (dominance/epistatic) control.

questions.q_en: The Norin-10 gene, which underpinned the Green Revolution in wheat, confers:
questions.q_hi: गेहूँ में हरित क्रांति का आधार बने नोरिन-10 जीन का गुण है:
questions.exp_en: Norin-10 from the Japanese variety Norin 10 (via Gaines) carries reduced-height genes Rht-B1b/Rht-D1b that shorten the stem, resist lodging and let high nitrogen doses raise yield.

questions.q_en: Epigeal germination, in which cotyledons are lifted above the soil surface, occurs in:
questions.q_hi: अधिभूमि (एपिजियल) अंकुरण, जिसमें बीजपत्र मृदा सतह से ऊपर उठ जाते हैं, होता है:
questions.exp_en: Soybean, cotton, castor and papaya show epigeal germination (hypocotyl elongates). Maize, wheat and rice are hypogeal, where the cotyledon stays below ground.

questions.q_en: Gibberellins were first isolated from the fungus responsible for the 'foolish seedling' disease of rice, namely:
questions.q_hi: धान के 'फूलिश सीडलिंग' रोग के कारक कवक से गिबरेलिन सर्वप्रथम पृथक किए गए, जो है:
questions.exp_en: Gibberella fujikuroi (Fusarium moniliforme) causes bakanae/foolish seedling disease; its gibberellic acid causes excessive stem elongation. GA3 is now the most widely used commercial gibberellin.

questions.q_en: Which Indian buffalo breed is preferred globally for dairy genetic improvement because of high milk and fat yield?
questions.q_hi: उच्च दूध एवं वसा उपज के कारण विश्व स्तर पर डेयरी आनुवंशिक सुधार हेतु कौन-सी भारतीय भैंस नस्ल पसंद की जाती है?
questions.exp_en: Murrah (Haryana–Punjab belt) is the world's most sought-after dairy buffalo breed, with average fat around 7%. Best milch animals give 15–20 litres/day; Bhadawari is known for very high fat.

questions.q_en: The gestation period of sheep is about:
questions.q_hi: भेड़ का गर्भाधान काल लगभग है:
questions.exp_en: Sheep: about 147 days (≈5 months). Goat: 150 days, cattle: 280 days, buffalo: 310 days and camel: 390 days.

questions.q_en: The scientific name of the tiger shrimp (tiger prawn) is:
questions.q_hi: टाइगर झींगा (टाइगर प्रॉन) का वैज्ञानिक नाम है:
questions.exp_en: Penaeus monodon is the black tiger shrimp (brackish water); P. vannamei is the exotic whiteleg shrimp, M. rosenbergii is freshwater prawn (scampi) and Scylla serrata is the mud crab.

questions.q_en: In Rogers' adoption–diffusion model, the 'laggards' are:
questions.q_hi: रोजर्स के अंगीकरण–विसरण मॉडल में 'लेगार्ड्स' हैं:
opts_en: The last group to adopt an innovation, being traditional and resistance to change
opts_hi: नवाचार अपनाने वाला अंतिम समूह, जो परंपरागत व परिवर्तन-विरोधी है
questions.exp_en: Rogers classes: innovators (2.5%), early adopters (13.5%), early majority (34%), late majority (34%) and laggards (16%) — the last to adopt, most resistant to change.

questions.q_en: Since 2018-19, the minimum support price is fixed at 1.5 times which cost concept?
questions.q_hi: 2018-19 से न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य किस लागत संकल्पना की 1.5 गुनी पर निर्धारित किया जाता है?
questions.exp_en: Since 2018-19, MSP is fixed at 1.5 times Cost A2+FL (paid-out cost plus imputed family labour). Farmer organisations demand 1.5 × C2 (which includes imputed rent and interest); the Kisan Long March raised this.

questions.q_en: A farmer sets up a processing unit with fixed cost of ₹6,00,000, selling price ₹200 per unit and variable cost ₹120 per unit. The break-even quantity is:
questions.q_hi: एक किसान ₹6,00,000 की स्थिर लागत वाला प्रसंस्करण इकाई लगाता है; विक्रय मूल्य ₹200 प्रति इकाई तथा परिवर्ती लागत ₹120 प्रति इकाई है। ब्रेक-ईवन मात्रा है:
questions.exp_en: BEP = Fixed cost ÷ (Price − Variable cost) = 6,00,000 ÷ (200 − 120) = 6,00,000 ÷ 80 = 7,500 units. Beyond 7,500 units every extra unit adds ₹80 of contribution.

questions.q_en: Under PM-KUSUM, the Central Financial Assistance for solar irrigation pumps (Component-B) is about:
questions.q_hi: पीएम-कुसुम के अंतर्गत सौर सिंचाई पंप (घटक-B) पर केंद्रीय वित्तीय सहायता लगभग है:
questions.exp_en: PM-KUSUM Component-B gives 30% Central Financial Assistance, 30% state subsidy and the remaining about 40% as a bank loan to the farmer. Components A (solar plants on barren land) and C (solarisation of existing pumps) have different provisions.

questions.q_en: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana assures a minimum monthly pension to small and marginal farmers of:
questions.q_hi: प्रधानमंत्री किसान मानधन योजना लघु एवं सीमांत किसानों को न्यूनतम मासिक पेंशन का आश्वासन देती है:
questions.exp_en: PM-KMY gives a minimum assured pension of ₹3,000 per month after 60 years of age to small and marginal farmers (up to 2 ha), with a matching central contribution; it is administered by LIC.
